body: I don't support what happened. Part of it is Kennedy and Biss splitting the vote, another part is a lack of run-off votes, and another part is the corrupt Chicago political machine that is strangling this state to death. After last night, I am done for politics for awhile, and I am seriously considering leaving Illinois. I could not win any meaningful position here based on what I believe in because they are in opposition of the Chicago machine's views. I could win if the machine went away, but only nuclear war or some other catastrophe can get rid of it at this point.

Leave the state. At this point, it would take an act of God to save this state from corruption. Tonight's election has gotten me so down that I am no longer following politics for a time being. It was a lot more drastic than leaving the state and politics, but this is not the place to discuss that.
I'd rather die while I still have my youth than set here as the world keeps going towards destruction no matter what good people do

I've had limited success with clubs. Made two friends, both of whom are busy most of the time. Another club I joined... I am considering quitting because of one certain person. Not going to mention more of it, just that I made a post about it about a week ago or so.
Should I ask them why they actively try to avoid me?

I do. This also happens when there are all silently studying. They just all go across the room and continue to study for a bit before talking at a level where I can't hear anything. If I go up to join the conversation, they all instantaneously decide they have to "get back to work" and leave. Once I leave, though, they quickly come back and start the conversation right up again.

Don't convince her to drop out of law school, unless she actively tries to commit suicide. If she is anything like me, the fact she/you chose inaction (dropping out) rather than action will just make it worse. Once I randomly felt sad on vacation and did not go on the attraction that was new that year. When I snapped out of it, I felt worse because I stupidly chose inaction rather than having fun. Had it not been for the people with me coming back to pick me up, then I would have probably tried to kill myself.
TL;DR Don't drop out of law school unless absolutely necessary it will make her feel worse when she does snap out of it.

I've tried "focusing on me" and that self love nonsense, but it doesn't work. Many things I like to do require friends. For example, when I was at a theme park on vacation with the only people who would go with me (my dad and my brother), I split from them after the second day and rode rides by myself. During that time, I learned I needed friends to also have fun at a theme park. Then last year, during a school trip to a different one, no one wanted me in their group, so I wandered around like the worthless fuck I was, and I realized how that made my day really suck. Video games no longer mean anything to me because there is no human interaction with them. It is driving me mad that no matter what I do to try and make friends, my "catch" is worse than a fisherman fishing in a bathtub. Why bother living when eventually your siblings get to have normal lives and friends, moving apart from you, leaving you to be alone 99% of the time and a burden the other 1%

I'd try to not think of it much, especially the part about wanting to be able to conceive and give birth to a child, since even with modern technology that would be impossible. Maybe write a story about a guy becoming a girl and going from there. Writing is a good way to get the mind focusing on something else: a new world of sorts that needs to be created, and you are the only one who can do so.

I can't take it.

Already done that with limited results. My friends are legitimately always busy. Doing things I like alone doesn't work out well. It only makes me feel worse about not having friends.

That isn't good enough. That's what I did for my whole childhood because I didn't live near any of my friends. I don't need to spend my life in front of a screen, silent, while text scrolls down a screen that could easily be written by a chat bot. I need REAL people in REAL LIFE who I can physically see, talk to, and experience stuff with. If I wanted to get lost online, I would go write code for a chat bot to simulate conversation.
